name: frontend
description: Frontend engineering for browser-facing applications: component and browser contracts, semantic accessibility, UI systems, responsive behavior, security, resilient user states, and feature ownership. Use when building or auditing frontend contracts, styling infrastructure, browser integrations, or file organization. Use typescript for language-wide modeling, narrowing, generics, assertions, and runtime type evidence; use react for React composition, state, effects, Suspense, and rendering; use nextjs-app-architecture for Next.js-specific mechanics.
